name: gordon-skills
description: Curated Claude Code skill sets, installable per feature area.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Gordon's always-on workflow set: /work (plan, build, verify, PR with an autonomy dial), /review (PR and branch review with a depth dial), /skill-fix, the azure context skill, envlock, cross-agent runners for Codex and Antigravity, and the hooks that enforce them.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: PR lifecycle automation: autopilot PRs, branch and PR review, diff-only blind reviews, backlog triage, unattended approval sweeps, Dependabot batches, GitHub issue planning and security alerts, file uploads.

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Writing and media production: voice work, long-form and social content, branded infographics and decks, and demo-video recording and QA.

plugins.name: global
plugins.description: General-purpose skills not tied to one project: secret management, plan review, and other cross-cutting helpers.

plugins.name: community
plugins.description: Submitting to and interacting with community platforms and directories, starting with Tiny Tool Town tool submissions.
